description: This file defines the interface IPluginStarter, which provides a method to activate a Thunder plugin with retry logic. It includes licensing information, include directives, and a pure virtual function for plugin activation.

classes.name: IPluginStarter
classes.description: An abstract interface class to start and activate a Thunder plugin, with a method to attempt activation with retries.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Pure virtual method to activate a plugin with specified maximum retries and delay between retries.
